verdict.rationale: Fellow's own docs offer recording 'with a visible bot', which is a form of in-meeting disclosure, and 'organization-wide policies for how meetings are recorded'. Neither is explicitly described as a consent or transparency control, and the botless desktop-capture option cuts against disclosure. Missing for 10: documented participant recording notifications or consent prompts, explicit in-meeting disclosure messages or banners, admin enforcement of disclosure (e.g. forcing a visible bot or blocking silent capture), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, the product ships real consent features — participant notifications, in-meeting disclosure, or admin-enforced transparency — not just a policy PDF

citations.quote: Fellow gives teams the flexibility to record with a visible bot or without one
Set organization-wide policies for how meetings are recorded, accessed, and retained
